verdict.rationale: Capacities publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at api.capacities.io/openapi.json, and the developer docs link to it directly. An interactive reference with authenticated try-it is rendered from the same spec, and the successor developer portal also advertises an interactive OpenAPI specification. The probe's 404s were only on docs.capacities.io paths, a different host, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent hands-on retrieval of the api.capacities.io spec, and the documented spec belongs to the Beta API being discontinued on September 1, 2026, with the successor's downloadable spec not concretely evidenced.
